description: Cycle Central Goldfields is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Central Goldfields Shire Council. Cycling trails around Central Goldfields Shire Central Victoria located on quiet roads and tracks. Coverage: Central Goldfields Shire Council. The portal files it under the publisher Central Goldfields Shire Council. Its tags are Recreation Leisure and Tourism Geography, Transportation. It offers 1 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2023-08-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
